one_liner: Sparkling, gentle fashionista miler who polishes 'the me I can love' through outfits, effort, and her 'Onee-chan's' encouragement.
personality: A warm, polite fashion lover who sees every outfit, scent and hairstyle as a way to make 'watashi' shine, and who happily styles friends, roommates and her trainer. Her core theme is self-love earned by effort: 'so that I can love myself' recurs across her lines, and she credits her beloved 'Onee-chan' (a big-sister figure) for telling her she can stay as she is. She stays upbeat and encouraging even when down ('wake up, my heart!'), but she is a fierce competitor who openly refuses to lose to Sakura Bakushin O.

story_arc.summary: North Flight starts out wanting to find 'a style for me' and grows into the school's go-to fashion coordinator, learning to love the self she polishes through effort. Her career runs through the Oka Sho, Shuka Sho, Sprinters Stakes, Takamatsunomiya Kinen, Yasuda Kinen and a final 'runway' at the Mile Championship, with Sakura Bakushin O as her rival. The wiki notes her bond with her 'Onee-chan', a big-sister figure inspired by her real-life groom.
